blocks.text: To edit an isolation policy rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Access > Isolation Policy.
Locate the isolation policy rule you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change an isolation policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter in a new value on the Isolation Policy page.

blocks.item: In the Edit Rule window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring Isolation Policies.
